title: Axiom: WLU is Work, Not Money
summary: Work Load Units (WLU) are dimensionless normalized amounts of work, intentionally decoupled from financial currency or pricing.
why: Decoupling allows schedulers to manage delivery capacity (WLU/s) and work limits without needing to understand external currency, provider invoices, or internal chargeback rates.
invariants: WLU does not represent money or currency.
Currency and chargeback rates are outside the WLU authority.
Acceleration (parallelism) does not multiply the total work amount (WLU), though it may increase the delivery demand (WLU/s).
